preconditions.description: The number of testcases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50000 and 1 <= m <= 10 for n, m in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each testcase, n is between 1 and 5*10^4, and m is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= m and len(set(p)) == m for p in perms) for perms in all_testcase_perms)
preconditions.description: Each permutation contains m distinct integers from 1 to m.
The sum of n over all testcases does not exceed 5*10^4.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each testcase.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line, n in zip(output_lines, testcase_ns))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= val <= m for val in line_vals) for line_vals in output_integers_list)
postconditions.description: Every output value is an integer between 0 and m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(max_beauty(i, perms) == output_integers_list[i][k] for i in range(t) for k in range(len(perms[i])))
postconditions.description: For each testcase i and each permutation index k, the output value equals the maximum beauty of the product a_k * a_j over all j in that testcase.
